question: How many new stores did Tanishq open in the last year?
answer: If “last year” means FY2025–26, Tanishq added 27 stores net in India, calculated from quarterly additions of 3, 6, 10 and 8. These figures come from a single company source—Titan’s quarterly disclosures—and measure net additions, not gross new-store openings. I could not find a full-year worldwide total of new Tanishq store openings in the supplied evidence.

retrieval.text:
**Titan’s latest annual report is FY 2025–26**, listed as “Annual Report 2026” on its official website, as of September 14, 2026. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/investors/annual-reports))

### Tanishq store additions for FY 2025–26
Titan’s official quarterly disclosures report:

| Period | India: net Tanishq store additions |
|---|---:|
| Q1: April–June 2025 | 3 ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-07/Q1FY26%20-%20Quaterly%20Update%20%28Uploaded%29.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| Q2: July–September 2025 | 6 ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-10/Q2FY26%20-%20Quarterly%20Update%20_Uploaded.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| Q3: October–December 2025 | 10 ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2026-01/Quarterly%2520Update%2520-%2520Q3FY26%2520-%2520SE%2520Uploaded.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| Q4: January–March 2026 | 8 ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/news/titan-FY26-results?utm_source=openai)) |
| **FY 2025–26 total (calculated)** | **27** |

These are **net additions in India**, not gross openings, and exclude Mia, Zoya and CaratLane. Separately, Titan reported **four new Tanishq store openings in the GCC during Q4 FY26**. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-07/Q1FY26%20-%20Quaterly%20Update%20%28Uploaded%29.pdf?utm_source=openai))

**Source limitation:** I located the latest annual-report PDF, but it exceeded the retrieval tool’s size limit. The figures above therefore come from Titan’s quarterly disclosures—not a verified annual-report passage.

retrieval.text:
**If you mean FY2024–25 (April 1, 2024–March 31, 2025), Tanishq added 43 stores net**, increasing its network from **479 to 522 stores**, according to Motilal Oswal’s July 21, 2025 review of Titan’s annual report. This is net expansion, not necessarily gross store openings. ([images.moneycontrol.com](https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2025/07/20250721092422_Titan-Company-21072025-Motilal.pdf))

A related **Economic Times** article, *“Fewer karats brighten up Tanishq, give Titan lustre,”* dated **November 6, 2025**, reported **17 new Tanishq stores in FY2025–26 through October**, against a **full-year target of 40**—a different reporting period. ([m.economictimes.com](https://m.economictimes.com/markets/stocks/news/fewer-karats-brighten-up-tanishq-give-titan-lustre/amp_articleshow/125121023.cms))

I couldn’t identify a Reuters report matching your exact wording. Are you referring to **calendar 2025**, **FY2024–25**, or “last year” in an older article?
